claims: Rick Pitino is the head men's basketball coach at St. John's University.
Rick Pitino was hired on March 20, 2023.
Rick Pitino was hired as the 22nd coach in St. John's University men's basketball program history.
Rick Pitino's third season at St. John's University was 2025-26.
Rick Pitino led St. John's University men's basketball team to a 30-6 record in the 2025-26 season.
Rick Pitino led St. John's University men's basketball team to a Top-25 ranking in the 2025-26 season.
St. John's University men's basketball team made a 2026 NCAA Tournament Sweet 16 appearance.
Rick Pitino won an NCAA National Championship with Kentucky in 1996.
Rick Pitino won an NCAA National Championship with Louisville in 2013.
Rick Pitino was a 2013 Naismith Memorial Basketball Hall of Fame inductee.
St. John's University men's basketball coaching staff includes Associate Head Coach Steve Masiello
